description: Evidence-based MITRE ATT&CK technique mappings for CyberGraph. Only techniques supported by available network telemetry are included.

T1046.description: Adversaries scan for service configurations to identify exposed services and potential attack vectors.
supported_evidence: High destination-port diversity from same source
Multiple short-lived connections to different services
Repeated connection attempts from same source IP
Service probing patterns in short time window

T1110.description: Adversaries attempt multiple login combinations to guess passwords.
supported_evidence: Repeated authentication attempts from same source
High connection rate to authentication services
Multiple login attempts to same target

T1498.description: Adversaries disrupt network services by overwhelming targets with traffic.
supported_evidence: High connection rate to single target

T1059.description: Adversaries execute commands or scripts to accomplish objectives.
